admin.title: Logo Manager
admin.description: SVG logos, a header that grows with them, effects, and a seasonal schedule.
admin.enabled_help: Turn everything below off in one place without losing your settings.
admin.logo_help: SVG, PNG, JPEG, WebP or an animated GIF. Flarum's own logo setting refuses SVG and shrinks everything else to 60 pixels tall; this one does neither.
admin.logo_dark_help: Shown when a visitor is using a dark colour scheme. Optional.
admin.no_logo: No logo yet — the forum title is shown instead.
admin.height_help: How tall the logo is drawn. Flarum's fixed maximum is 30 pixels.
admin.height_phone_help: Applies inside the slide-out drawer, where the header lives on a small screen.
admin.header_height_help: Automatic keeps Flarum's own spacing around the logo and never goes below the standard 52 pixels.
admin.align_help: Centring moves the navigation to the left of the logo and the account controls to the right.
admin.plate_enabled: Draw a plate behind the logo
admin.plate_help: Useful when a logo was drawn for a white background and the header is not one.
admin.effects_help: Applied live in the browser, so they work on an SVG and a photo alike and nothing is baked into the file.
admin.recolor_enabled: Replace every colour with one colour
admin.recolor_help: Keeps the logo's shape and fills it with a single colour. Best with a logo that has a transparent background.
admin.shadow_enabled: Drop a shadow behind the logo
admin.seasons_help: Give the logo a different look for part of the year. The first rule whose dates match is the one that runs, so put a single day above the month it sits in.
admin.seasons_timezone_help: Which clock decides when a season starts and ends.
admin.season_presets: Or start from one of these
admin.season_logo_help: Optional. Shown instead of the usual logo for as long as the season runs, without changing your permanent one.
admin.season_decoration_help: A small ornament pinned to a corner of the logo.
admin.season_weather_help: Particles drifting across the whole header.
admin.season_effects: Override the effects while this season runs
admin.season_preview: See this season on the forum (only you see it; saved settings)
admin.season_email_on: Emails sent while this season runs carry this logo too.
admin.season_email_off: Emails keep the usual logo — this file could not be made into one mail clients can show.
admin.season_favicon_help: Optional. Shown in the browser tab while the season runs.
admin.favicon_help: The icon in the browser tab, bookmarks and the phone home screen. Upload an SVG, ICO, PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF. From an SVG, PNG and ICO copies are made for browsers that do not show SVG, plus a home-screen icon. This replaces the favicon in Appearance.
admin.favicon_no_fallbacks: Your browser could not draw this SVG, so only browsers that support SVG favicons will show it. Upload it again from Chrome, or upload a PNG.
admin.report_summary: {count, plural, one {# thing needs a look} other {# things need a look}} — open the report
admin.report_ok: Everything checks out. Every file is in place and every season can run.
admin.report_missing_file: The {slot} for {where} is missing from the server. {fix}
admin.report_broken_file: The {slot} for {where} cannot be read as an image. {fix}
admin.report_fix_logo: To fix it, upload the logo again in Logo Manager → Logo.
admin.report_fix_seasons: To fix it, upload that season's logo again in Logo Manager → Seasons.
admin.report_fix_favicon: To fix it, upload the favicon again in Logo Manager → Favicon.
admin.report_email_settings_missing_file: The email logo uploaded on Flarum's Appearance page is missing from the server, so emails show a broken image. Upload it again under Email logo on the Appearance page, or remove it there to use your Logo Manager logo in emails.
admin.report_email_settings_broken_file: The email logo uploaded on Flarum's Appearance page cannot be read as an image. Upload it again under Email logo on the Appearance page, or remove it there to use your Logo Manager logo in emails.
admin.report_never_runs: {season} has no valid dates, so it never runs.
admin.report_shadowed: {season} will not show in the next twelve months: a season above it in the list always wins on its dates.
admin.report_upcoming_broken: {season} starts {date} with a problem below — fix it before then.
admin.report_ending_soon: The permanent look comes back on {date}, when {season} ends.
admin.report_email_no_logo: Your logo is a WebP image and has no email copy, so emails go out without a logo. Upload the logo again in Logo Manager → Logo, or add one under Email logo on Flarum's Appearance page.
admin.report_email_svg_no_copy: Your logo is an SVG and has no PNG copy for emails, which cannot show SVG — so emails go out without a logo. Make the copy with the button, or add one under Email logo on Flarum's Appearance page.
admin.report_email_svg_missing: The email logo for {where} is missing from the server. Its logo is an SVG, so make the email copy again with the button.
admin.report_email_uses_settings: Emails use the logo uploaded under Email logo on Flarum's Appearance page. Logo Manager's own email copies are not used while it is set.
admin.report_email_remade: The email copy of the logo for {where} had gone missing from the server. It has been made again from the logo, so there is nothing to do.
admin.report_disabled: Logo Manager is switched off, so none of this is showing on the forum.
admin.report_seasons_off: Seasons are switched off, so the schedule is not running.
admin.backup_export_help: Everything on this page — sizes, effects, every season, and the logo, favicon and seasonal image files — in one JSON file.
admin.backup_import_help: Load a backup from this or another forum, for example one you set up on a local copy. It replaces everything on this page; files in it are checked like any upload.
admin.backup_import_confirm: Replace the whole Logo Manager setup with this backup?
admin.backup_invalid: That is not a Logo Manager backup, or it is damaged.
admin.backup_file: A file in that backup is not an image that can be stored safely. Nothing was changed.
admin.backup_imported: {count, plural, one {Imported, with # file.} other {Imported, with # files.}} Reloading…
admin.season_empty: No seasons yet. Add one, or start from a preset below.
admin.preview_note: A mock-up of your header. Save to apply it to the forum.

errors.invalid_svg: That SVG could not be read. It may be damaged, or it may be an image with an .svg name.
errors.invalid_image: That file is not an image Flarum can read.
errors.unsupported_type: Use an SVG, PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF.
errors.too_large_svg: That SVG is larger than 512 KB. An SVG logo is normally a few kilobytes — a very large one usually has an image embedded in it.
errors.too_large_raster: That image is larger than 8 MB.
errors.too_many_pixels: That image has too many pixels to process safely.
errors.not_svg: That logo is no longer an SVG. Check the report again.

views.preview_season: Preview: the {season} season. Only you can see this.
views.preview_permanent: Preview: the permanent look. Only you can see this.
